text:
Incident Bot: [ALERT] P1 - Dedicated GPU pool (us-west-2) for tenant AcmeCorp showing 50% dropped sessions and tail latency spikes >5s. Trigger: pool-health-degraded. Paging @Eng Oncall.
Sarah W: I'm oncall, checking now. Any immediate errors in logs?
Lee T: joining — pulling dyndb and runtime logs for dp-47.
Miguel P: note: Acme is on Dedicated VPC, pool id dp-47. Isolation rules + reserved capacity. If this is pool-level, multiple tenants might be affected but we only see Acme traffic patterns now.
Sarah W: seeing repeated `kv_cache::alloc_failed` in runtime logs and a surge of long seq requests. snippets:
```
[2026-07-14T12:01:11Z] runtime.error: kv_cache::alloc_failed tenant=acme pool=dp-47 model=gpt-large seq_len=4096 usage=98%
[2026-07-14T12:01:13Z] runtime.warn: tokenize slow path triggered
```
Anya K: mitigation proposal quick: 1) route Acme to fallback pool dp-52 2) throttle long-sequence models for Acme 3) apply runtime patch to reject extreme seqs and clear KV cache 4) notify Acme CS + schedule postmortem. Implementable without downtime.
Jordan C: executing route change now:
```
$ rictl route add --tenant acme --from dp-47 --to dp-52 --type fallback --priority 10
OK: route added, propagating to us-west-2
```
Eng Oncall: route applied — initial check: 80% requests now 200, some 503s still from warm-up. Rolling traffic over ~2 minutes. I'm disabling the high-mem model variant for Acme:
```
$ rictl model pin --tenant acme --model gpt-large:v2 --alias gpt-large:quantized-small
OK: alias updated
```
Customer Success Bot: I've pinged Acme SRE (alice@acme) and told them we're routing to fallback and working on a fix. They asked for ETA.
Sarah W: ETA ~25m to have stable responses across all endpoints; leaving fallback in place until fully validated. We'll keep customer informed.
Miguel P: initial root cause hypothesis: KV cache growth + a recent dedupe change in model tokenizer that increases seq retention. Need runtime heap traces and model artifact diff.
Anya K: I'm starting the RCA doc and will include timeline and customer impact. cc @Exec Ops — we may need to propose a bespoke SLA credit since this is a reserved pool.
Jordan C: suggest proactive credit: reserved capacity SLA states 99.9% monthly uptime. For ~40m impact window, propose 10% credit for the billing period; flag to finance/legal.
Exec Ops: please prepare an exec-safe summary (1p) with timeline, customer impact, mitigation, and proposed credit. We'll loop in Sales/AE for customer outreach.
Sarah W: Drafting the exec note now. I'll also create ACME-INC-179100 in Jira and add runbook items for tenant-level failover and KV cache thresholds.
Customer Success Bot: Acme requested a post-incident runbook and a live walkthrough. Proposed time: tomorrow 16:00 PST. Will confirm and send calendar invite.
Lee T: running additional diagnostics: heap profiles + model artifact hash compare. Pulling /var/log/runtime/profiles/*. Will attach to RCA.
Anya K: action items: (a) Jordan to postmortem model change diff, (b) Lee to upload heap profiles, (c) Sarah to send exec + customer comms + create Jira, (d) CS to schedule runbook call. I'll own the RCA draft.
Eng Oncall: handing off monitoring to Lee T — I'm going offline in ~10m but reachable if needed. Leaving fallback active and monitoring.
Sarah W: thanks all. If anything regresses, start escalation to SEV2 and tag @exec-ops. I'll update the status page: "Investigating -> Mitigated (fallback)" and update at +30m.
Customer Success Bot: Acme confirmed receipt and appreciated prompt action :thumbsup:. They asked for a written summary and credit proposal — CS will deliver after exec review.
Anya K: will include timeline, root cause, remediation, and proposed SLA credit in RCA. Planning internal postmortem review in 48 hours. :spiral_notepad:
Incident Bot: Incident marked "mitigated" at 1791002660 by Eng Oncall; fallback routing remains enabled until RCA complete.
Sarah W: closing handoff — last check in ~20m and then close thread. Thank you everyone. :pray:
